name: Stefan's Pasteria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Stefan’s Pasteria in Seefeld in Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy **Apfelstrudel**, and freshly baked **Brez’n**—all made with love in the heart of the Alps. Whether you’re craving a sweet treat or a hearty snack, our traditional Austrian pastries and savory specialties will warm your soul.

Located just a short stroll from Seefeld’s charming center, we’re your perfect stop after a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**. Come by for a cozy break, a quick coffee, or a full breakfast to start your adventure.

**Prost!** We look forward to serving you.
